choose.when: select b.lead_id business_id,b.lead_no business_no,b.lead_name business_name,'LEAD' business_type from biz_lead b where b.del_flag='0' and b.lead_id=#{businessId} and (b.lead_no like concat('%',#{keyword},'%') or b.lead_name like concat('%',#{keyword},'%'))

select b.customer_id business_id,b.customer_no business_no,b.customer_name business_name,'CUSTOMER' business_type from biz_customer b where b.del_flag='0' and b.customer_id=#{businessId} and (b.customer_no like concat('%',#{keyword},'%') or b.customer_name like concat('%',#{keyword},'%'))

select b.contract_id business_id,b.contract_no business_no,b.contract_name business_name,'CONTRACT' business_type from biz_contract b where b.del_flag='0' and b.contract_id=#{businessId} and (b.contract_no like concat('%',#{keyword},'%') or b.contract_name like concat('%',#{keyword},'%'))

select b.case_id business_id,b.case_no business_no,b.case_name business_name,'CASE' business_type from biz_case b where b.del_flag='0' and b.case_id=#{businessId} and (b.case_no like concat('%',#{keyword},'%') or b.case_name like concat('%',#{keyword},'%'))

select b.case_id business_id,b.case_no business_no,b.case_name business_name,'MATTER' business_type from biz_case b where b.del_flag='0' and b.case_id=#{businessId} and (b.case_no like concat('%',#{keyword},'%') or b.case_name like concat('%',#{keyword},'%'))
choose.otherwise: select null business_id,null business_no,null business_name,null business_type where 1=0

mapper.select: order by business_id desc limit #{limit} offset #{offset}
